title: Crispy Tacos with Tomato Topping
description: My FAVORITE way to make crispy tacos (just like my dad used to!) 🌮

ingredients.item: Corn tortillas (fresh or softened in microwave)
Optional toppings: shredded cheese, lettuce, salsa, etc.

steps: Heat oil in a pan and sauté diced onion until soft.
Add minced garlic to the pan and cook until fragrant.
Add ground beef to the pan and cook until browned.
Stir in tomato bouillon, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Pour in the reserved tomato juice and half a can of beer.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, then uncover and simmer until liquid reduces.
While the meat simmers, prepare tortillas: wrap older tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for 30 seconds.
Heat oil in a deep pan for frying.
Test oil temperature with a broken tortilla piece; if it sizzles and turns into a chip, oil is ready.
Stuff meat into tortillas, hold upright for 10 seconds, then fry each side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and keep warm in a low oven.
Serve tacos topped with stewed tomatoes and optional toppings.
notes:
Ensure tortillas are fresh or properly softened for best results. Fry in batches and keep warm in a low oven.
